about.title: About Speed Duel: Battle City Box
paragraphs: Speed Duel: Battle City Box is a Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG pack released on 26 November 2020, in the SEVENS & GO RUSH!! era. It has 223 cards, and with the 21 other rarities there are 244 to collect in all.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 223 cards, each in its main rarity) or the Master set (all 244, adding the 21 other rarities).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details and images come from YGOPRODeck, and prices from TCGplayer.
